verdict.rationale: Activepieces' core flow model is a trigger followed by actions. The docs say actions run when the flow is activated, which is event-triggered automation in the Zapier style the project explicitly replaces. Agents also handle incoming work as it arrives. Missing for 10: documentation of specific event trigger types (e.g. app events, webhooks, schedules), evidence of conditional/branching rule logic, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Flow consists of two parts, trigger and actions
Actions come after the trigger and control what occurs when the flow is activated, like running code or communicating with other services.
An open source replacement for Zapier
it handles the work as it arrives
